system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:46 UTC, ivy.chen ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-NWD-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\ivy.chen\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; a file at that destination was created seconds later.
At 13:45:32 UTC, ivy.chen launched Chrome to quickshare-drop.net.

Shortly afterward, the proxy recorded a successful CONNECT tunnel to quickshare-drop.net with 51,000,000 client-to-server tunnel bytes and 8,800 server-to-client bytes; Zeek recorded a matching connection with about 51 MB sent.
The archive-then-large-outbound-transfer sequence to a file-sharing destination not listed among approved services strongly supports suspected data exfiltration.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available records show the archive command and creation of c.zip, but do not show the archive's contents, size, or hash (T039-00104, T039-00106).
The proxy and Zeek records quantify bytes through the tunnel, but do not establish that the destination application accepted or retained the data (T039-00138, T039-00140).
The records do not reveal ivy.chen's authorization or intent.
claims_not_established: That c.zip contained all or any particular client files; the command specifies the source path, but no file-level contents are present in the records (T039-00104, T039-00106).
That the destination received and stored a complete archive, rather than merely receiving the recorded tunnel traffic (T039-00138, T039-00140).
That ivy.chen acted with malicious intent or lacked a business justification.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire c.zip and relevant filesystem metadata, including its size, hash, and contents, if it remains available.
Obtain destination-side upload or account records, or other evidence confirming what was uploaded and whether it was retained.
Verify with the data owner and ivy.chen whether this transfer was authorized and identify any approved business purpose.
